title: One home for the record view types
evidence: lib/api-types.ts is the one home: roadmap-store.ts now imports ApiLabValue, ApiDocument, ApiMedicationHistory, ApiSupplement, LatestMeasurementsResult, AddMeasurementResult, BulkSaveResult and BulkLabValuesResult from it and drops its nine copies (the ninth, ApiReminderPreference, was unused there). Only difference: its ApiLabValue lacked the optional comparator (type-only; loadLabValues already casts the file rows). health-core document-save.ts DocumentView is a third shape of ApiDocument (fileRef/contentHash required), left for a health-core lead
durability_check: none: tsc does not stop a file declaring its own interface with the same name
